sources.snippet: Production AI Observability Monitor Baseline Model Model Description This repository contains a small, transparent prototype model for Production AI teams need trace-level signals for latency, token growth, tool failures, and low-quality outputs. The model combines per-label token weights with IDF-weighted evidence retrieval.

sources.title: Observability in Generative AI - Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: Without rigorous assessment, AI systems risk generating responses that are inaccurate, inconsistent, poorly grounded, or potentially harmful. Observability enables teams to measure and improve both the quality and safety of AI outputs throughout the development lifecycle - from model selection through production monitoring.
